description: JUnit test class 'DbModeSimulationTest' validating the behavior of EnvironmentClassifier and HealthCheckHook under simulated database modes. It tests classification logic, diagnostic outputs, and mode differentiation for 'ON' and 'OFF' simulated database states.

classes.name: DbModeSimulationTest
classes.description: JUnit 5 test class that verifies environment classification and health check simulation modes related to database statuses.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Clears simulation property and resets health check cache before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Clears simulation property and resets health check cache after each test.

methods.name: testDbOnSimulationClassifiesCorrectly
methods.description: Checks that setting simulate DB ON produces correct classification as SIMULATED_DB_ON.

methods.name: testDbOnSimulationConsistency
methods.description: Verifies consistent classification outcome across multiple runs when simulating DB ON.

methods.name: testDbOnDiagnosticsContainSimulationInfo
methods.description: Ensures diagnostics include 'SIMULATION' info when simulating DB ON.

methods.name: testDbOffSimulationClassifiesCorrectly
methods.description: Checks that simulate DB OFF classifies as SIMULATED_DB_OFF.

methods.name: testDbOffSimulationConsistency
methods.description: Verifies consistent classification across multiple runs when simulating DB OFF.

methods.name: testDbOffDiagnosticsContainDbDownInfo
methods.description: Checks diagnostics mention DB down or uninitialized when simulating DB OFF.

methods.name: testModesProduceDifferentStates
methods.description: Ensures different simulate modes produce different classification states.

methods.name: testIsSimulationModeReturnsTrue
methods.description: Verifies that environment reports simulation mode true when property is set.

methods.name: testIsSimulationModeReturnsFalse
methods.description: Verifies that environment reports simulation mode false when property is not set.

methods.name: testFormatSummaryProducesOutput
methods.description: Checks that classification summary produces non-empty, meaningful output.

methods.name: testFullSimulationRunnerProducesReport
methods.description: Confirms that the full simulation runner generates a report containing expected sections.

methods.name: testUnknownSimulationFlagValue
methods.description: Ensures graceful handling of invalid simulation property values.

methods.name: testClassificationDurationIsNonNegative
methods.description: Verifies classification result duration is non-negative.

methods.name: testMaskUtility
methods.description: Tests masking utility for sensitive values.
